tools.name: get_festival_dates
tools.description:
Hindu festivals, vrats and observances between two dates, soonest first, from DharmikVibes' verified
    festival calendar, including multi-day festivals such as Navratri with their end date. A date is given
    only when it has been checked against an independent official or temple source; festival

tools.name: get_panchang
tools.description:
Panchang for one day in one city: sunrise, sunset, moonrise and moonset there, and the tithi
    (with paksha), nakshatra, yoga and karana prevailing at that sunrise, each with the time it ends,
    plus any festival on DharmikVibes' verified calendar that day. Always states the city, time zone

tools.name: get_vrat_guide
tools.description:
Which vrats (fasts) fall on which dates: Ekadashi, Pradosh, Purnima, Amavasya, Karwa Chauth and
    others, with the deity, from DharmikVibes' verified festival calendar and DivineAI's vrat list. How a
    vrat is kept is included only once a scholar has checked that text.
